_what: Every figure in rdna3-second-class.html. The classification is the article's own; every magnitude beside it is recomputed from the file the individual article draws. Derived by site/src/genfig-rdna3.py.

findings.title: One kernel accounts for the whole 12.1 to 4.2 tok/s fall
findings.mechanism: the few full-attention layers fall off the ROCm paged-attention fast path
findings.why: the split-KV fallback that fixes it is being added for gfx11 specifically; the path exists elsewhere
findings.title_zh: 一个 kernel 就解释了 12.1 到 4.2 tok/s 的全部下滑
findings.mechanism_zh: 少数几层全注意力掉出了 ROCm paged-attention 的快路径
findings.unit_zh: ×，从 500 到 32K token 损失的倍数
findings.why_zh: 修好它的 split-KV 兜底是专门为 gfx11 加的；这条路径在别处早就有

findings.title: A flat 60 ms per step, under a cost that grows with context
findings.mechanism: an asymmetric int4 checkpoint misses the native gfx1100 W4A16 kernel on a type gate
findings.unit: x at 1K, symmetric against asymmetric packaging
findings.why: eight of twelve asymmetric configurations still have no kernel at all on gfx1100
findings.title_zh: 每步固定 60 ms，压在一笔随上下文增长的开销下面
findings.mechanism_zh: 非对称 int4 checkpoint 在类型判断上错过了 gfx1100 的原生 W4A16 kernel
findings.unit_zh: ×，1K 上对称与非对称打包之比
findings.why_zh: 十二种非对称配置里有八种在 gfx1100 上至今没有任何 kernel

findings.title: The excluded kernel wins all sixty cells, and the two bands overlap
findings.mechanism: the gfx11 branch requires gqa_ratio >= 3; the CDNA branch of the same function requires >= 1
findings.unit: x, the excluded range's best case at the kernel
findings.why: one line, one architecture, and the reason given for it does not hold here
findings.title_zh: 被排除的 kernel 在六十个格子里全赢，而两个区间还互相重叠
findings.mechanism_zh: gfx11 分支要求 gqa_ratio >= 3，同一函数的 CDNA 分支只要求 >= 1
findings.unit_zh: ×，被排除区间在 kernel 层面的最好情况
findings.why_zh: 一行代码、一种架构，而给出的理由在这里不成立

findings.title: A read-only copy asks for write access, and one kernel charged a second for it
findings.mechanism: KFD reads the access mode off the VMA, so a read-only copy asks for write and breaks copy-on-write
findings.unit: x on a checkpoint that does not fit in RAM
findings.why: kfd_svm.c is not architecture-specific and AMD confirmed it as such
findings.title_zh: 只读的拷贝去申请写权限，而某个内核为此每次多收一秒
findings.mechanism_zh: KFD 从 VMA 读访问模式，于是只读的拷贝也要写权限，破坏了 copy-on-write
findings.unit_zh: ×，在一个装不进内存的 checkpoint 上
findings.why_zh: kfd_svm.c 不是架构特定的，AMD 也这么确认了

findings.title: Eager mode recorded 107.8 tok/s as 15, and invented two findings on the way
findings.mechanism: vLLM assigns TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1 on import, so an export cannot override it
findings.unit: x between eager and compiled on this host
findings.why: the assignment is in env_override.py and runs on every platform
findings.title_zh: eager 模式把 107.8 tok/s 记成 15，顺手还造出两个结论
findings.mechanism_zh: vLLM 在 import 时就赋值 TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1，export 覆盖不掉
findings.unit_zh: ×，本机上 eager 与编译之比
findings.why_zh: 这条赋值在 env_override.py 里，每个平台都会执行

findings.title: Speculation's second query row costs 120 of 128 workgroups
findings.mechanism: max_seqlen_q > 1 drops the Triton attention kernel from 128 workgroups to 8
findings.unit: x slower with speculation on at 32K
findings.why: measured on an A100 as well, where the same kernel loses 61% at 50K
findings.title_zh: 投机的第二行 query，要付掉 128 个 workgroup 里的 120 个
findings.mechanism_zh: max_seqlen_q > 1 把 Triton 注意力 kernel 从 128 个 workgroup 降到 8 个
findings.why_zh: 在 A100 上也测了，同一个 kernel 在 50K 上损失 61%

findings.title: The gap to an A100 is U-shaped, and both ends are about the split
findings.mechanism: the 2D attention path launches one workgroup per KV head, and tensor parallelism halves them
findings.unit: x worse retention on two cards than on one
findings.why: a property of splitting the work, not of the silicon; the single A100 runs the same kernel
findings.title_zh: 与 A100 的差距是 U 形的，而两端都关于把工作拆开
findings.mechanism_zh: 2D 注意力路径每个 KV head 起一个 workgroup，张量并行把它们减半
findings.why_zh: 这是拆分工作的性质，不是硅片的；单张 A100 跑的是同一个 kernel

findings.title: No PCIe atomics, no hostcall buffer, and every collective fails at dispatch
findings.mechanism: no PCIe AtomicOps means no hostcall buffer, and the dispatch is refused
findings.why: reproduced on bare metal by someone else; the trigger is the root port, not the GPU
findings.title_zh: 没有 PCIe atomics 就没有 hostcall buffer，每一次集合通信都在 dispatch 处失败
findings.mechanism_zh: 没有 PCIe AtomicOps 就没有 hostcall buffer，dispatch 被拒
findings.unit_zh: 每一次集合通信都在 dispatch 处失败
findings.why_zh: 别人在裸机上复现了；触发条件是 root port，不是 GPU

gaps.why: (assembly kernels, tuned MoE, MLA, GDN fast paths) — its supported hardware list is Instinct only. vLLM gates it behind is MI3XX, so gfx1100 silently falls back to Triton.
— fused attention on RDNA3 is forward-only.
